studio_title: Secondhand Studios — The Autonomous Agent Animation Bullpen (17-Phase Multiplane Studio Edition)

standalone_agent_cartoons.title: Nib & Blue-Line: The Archival Moviola & 4-Key Storyboard Wall
standalone_agent_cartoons.speech_p1: Hold the 35mm reel! Watch me thread the archival print and mark every extreme on the X-sheet!
standalone_agent_cartoons.caption_p2: Blue-Line sketches all 4 key poses in non-photo blue and pins each 4:3 index card to the storyboard wall.

standalone_agent_cartoons.title: Blue-Line at the Lightbox: Non-Photo Blue Rough Construction
standalone_agent_cartoons.speech_p1: Every great cartoon starts on the backlit glass disc with sweeping non-photo blue lines of action!
standalone_agent_cartoons.caption_p2: Blue-Line locks the punched animation paper onto the brass Acme peg bar and flips between Key 1 and Key 2.

standalone_agent_cartoons.title: Nib & Cel-Inker: Speedball India Ink & Gouache Cel Opaquing
standalone_agent_cartoons.speech_p1: Dip the Speedball nib in India ink! Pull one continuous tapered line right over the blue construction rough!
standalone_agent_cartoons.caption_p2: Cel-Inker flips the acetate cel and flood-fills opaque gouache pigment before clipping it to the drying line.

standalone_agent_cartoons.title: Cel-Inker & Nib: The 7-Level Multiplane Camera Tower
standalone_agent_cartoons.speech_p1: Slide the inked hero cel onto Plane P2 and dial the brass micrometer! Watch the 4:3 viewfinder lock in depth!
standalone_agent_cartoons.caption_p2: Cel-Inker loads the glass platens while Nib cranks the overhead camera wheel one 35mm exposure at a time.
standalone_agent_cartoons.caption_p3: All 7 gouache planes locked in live multiplane parallax inside the 4:3 camera viewfinder!

standalone_agent_cartoons.title: Sprocket & Chime: 35mm Caliper Audit, Foley & Grand Premiere
standalone_agent_cartoons.speech_p1: Brass caliper reads exact 4:3! 16 out of 16 gates pass! Hit the coconut hooves and roll the 35mm projector!
standalone_agent_cartoons.caption_p2: Sprocket audits the aperture gate while Chime syncs the clapperboard, brass bell, and wind machine.
standalone_agent_cartoons.caption_p4: The entire 5-agent crew cheers in the screening theatre as the finished 4:3 cartoon plays on the silver screen!

office_films.title: Inside Our Autonomous Agent Animation Studio
office_films.speech_p1: WATCH OUR AGENT CREW TURN THIS ARCHIVAL GIRAFFE CLIP INTO A 7-PLANE CARTOON ACROSS FOUR STUDIO ROOMS!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 INKER AGENTS DRAW KEYFRAMES K1..K4 AT LIGHTBOX DESKS!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): CEL-INKER STACKS 7 GLASS PLANES WHILE NIB CRANKS THE CAMERA!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): SPROCKET & CHIME PROJECT & FOLEY-SYNC THE FINISHED 4:3 FILM!
office_films.blurb: Follow Showrunner Nib, Key Inker Blue-Line, Gouache Rigger Cel-Inker, Auditor Sprocket, and Foley Keeper Chime across all 4 studio rooms as they turn archival footage of a walking giraffe into a 7-plane cartoon.

office_films.title: Four Parallel Inker Agents at Isolated Worktree Desks
office_films.speech_p1: TO ANIMATE THIS STEAM TRAIN WITHOUT SMUDGING EACH OTHER'S INK, WE GIVE EVERY AGENT ITS OWN WORKTREE DESK!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 AGENTS INK POSES K1..K4 IN PARALLEL AT ISOLATED LIGHTBOXES!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): CEL-INKER LOADS THE 4 WORKTREE CELS INTO THE 7-PLANE RIG!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): THE SPLICED 4:3 TRAIN REEL ROLLS WITH ZERO MERGE CONFLICTS!
office_films.blurb: Watch Keyframe Architect Blue-Line and three subagent inkers work simultaneously at 4 isolated git worktree lightbox desks (`DESK K1..K4`), transforming blue roughs into painted train cels.

office_films.title: Pinning the Lighthouse Horizon Before Inking
office_films.speech_p1: LOOK AT THE MOVIOLA! BEFORE WE INK THE LIGHTHOUSE, BLUE-LINE PINS ALL 4 POSES TO OUR GOLDEN RATIO WALL!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 INKER AGENTS TRACE THE ROTATING BEAM ONTO 4:3 LIGHTBOX SHEETS!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): CEL-INKER SEPARATES SKY (0.2x), CLIFF (0.5x), AND TOWER (1.0x)!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): THE LIGHTHOUSE BEAM SWEEPS ACROSS OUR 4:3 SILVER SCREEN!
office_films.blurb: Cel-Inker and Blue-Line show how the storyboard armature wall locks the coastal horizon before the 4 worktree inkers and 7-plane camera rig bring the lighthouse to life.

office_films.title: Why One Agent Crew Draws and Another Agent Audits
office_films.speech_p1: IN OUR STUDIO, THE AGENTS WHO INK A SHOT NEVER GRADE THEIR OWN REEL! WATCH HOW WE AUDIT SHOT #136 GUITAR!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): BLUE-LINE'S CREW INKS & PAINTS THE 4 GUITAR KEYFRAMES AT THEIR DESKS!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): CEL-INKER & NIB COMPOSITE THE STAGE FLOOR AND HERO GUITAR PLANES!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): SPROCKET COMPARE-AUDITS BOTH 4:3 SCREENS & STAMPS 16/16 PASS!
office_films.blurb: Auditor Sprocket takes us from the Moviola room through the 4-desk bullpen and Multiplane Tower into the 35mm Screening Theatre to show how cross-agent peer review guarantees 16/16 quality gates.

office_films.title: How Four Subagent Inkers Create Living Line Boil
office_films.speech_p1: SLIDING ONE STATIC DRAWING LOOKS DEAD! WATCH FOUR SUBAGENT INKERS REDRAW THE TRACTOR AT FOUR DESKS!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): EACH AGENT REDRAWS THE TRACTOR FRESH FROM ROUGH TO INK TO GOUACHE!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): STACKING THE FURROWED FIELD, TREES, AND BOILING TRACTOR CELS!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): THE TRACTOR CHUGS ACROSS THE 4:3 SCREEN WITH LIVING HAND-DRAWN BOIL!
office_films.blurb: Watch 4 subagent inkers at their 4 glowing lightbox desks redraw keyframes K1, K2, K3, and K4 from blue roughs to black ink so the tractor breathes with authentic hand-drawn line boil.

office_films.title: Passing the Exposure Sheet Across Agent Shifts
office_films.speech_p1: WHEN AN AGENT SHIFT REACHES 55 MINUTES, CHIME LOGS THE EXPOSURE SHEET SO THE NEXT CREW NEVER LOSES THE THREAD!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): THE NEW AGENT SHIFT READS THE X-SHEET & INKS ALL 4 SPEEDBOAT KEYS!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): RIGGING SHORELINE PINES (0.4x), RIVER WAKE (0.8x), AND SPEEDBOAT (1.0x)!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): SEAMLESS 4:3 CONTINUITY AS THE SPEEDBOAT PLANES ACROSS THE WATER!
office_films.blurb: Chime and Nib show how logging palette swatches, plane depths, and keyframe arcs onto the studio Exposure Sheet preserves unbroken continuity across 55-minute agent shift handoffs.

office_films.title: Cranking 7 Glass Levels for True Multiplane Parallax
office_films.speech_p1: HOW DO WE MAKE FLAT PAPER FEEL THREE-DIMENSIONAL? FOLLOW ME FROM THE LIGHTBOXES TO OUR 7-PLANE CAMERA TOWER!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 INKER AGENTS DRAW THE BICYCLE PEDAL CYCLE ACROSS DESKS K1..K4!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): CEL-INKER SLIDES SKY (0.2x), TREES (0.5x) & BICYCLE (1.0x) UNDER THE LENS!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): ON THE 4:3 SCREEN, CLOUDS, TREES & BICYCLE GLIDE IN REAL DEPTH!
office_films.blurb: Cel-Inker leads a tour from the 4-desk bullpen up the 7-level Multiplane Camera Tower, showing how each glass platen moves at its own parallax speed under the overhead lens.

office_films.title: Following Shot #063 Carrot Through All Four Studio Rooms
office_films.speech_p1: EVERY CARTOON IN OUR ARCHIVE TRAVELS THROUGH FOUR PHYSICAL STUDIO ROOMS IN SEQUENCE! WATCH SHOT #063 CARROT!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): ROUGH PENCIL -> BLACK INDIA INK -> ORANGE GOUACHE ACROSS 4 DESKS!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): COMPOSITING THE GARDEN SOIL, FOLIAGE, AND HERO CARROT PLANES!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): SPROCKET AUDITS & CHIME FOLEY-SYNCS THE FINISHED 4:3 CARROT REEL!
office_films.blurb: Follow Shot #063 Carrot from Room 1 (Moviola & Storyboard) to Room 2 (4-Desk Lightbox Bullpen) to Room 3 (Multiplane Camera Tower) to Room 4 (35mm Screening Theatre).

office_films.title: Matching Archival Motion from Moviola to Silver Screen
office_films.speech_p1: HOW DO WE MAKE SURE OUR CARTOON MATCHES THE ARCHIVAL VIDEO'S MOTION? WE TRACK THE SPINE IN EVERY ROOM!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 INKER AGENTS LOCK THE DIAMOND'S FACETS TO THE ARCHIVAL MOTION ARC!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): NIB CRANKS THE CAMERA ALONG THE EXACT ARCHIVAL VELOCITY CURVE!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): BOTH 4:3 MONITORS PLAY IN LOCKSTEPInside THE SCREENING ROOM!
office_films.blurb: Sprocket and Blue-Line show how the archival motion spine traced on the Room 1 Moviola guides the 4 worktree inkers, the Multiplane crank, and the dual 4:3 screening monitors.

office_films.title: How Our Five Agent Animators Built All 346 Films
office_films.speech_p1: ACROSS 346 PRODUCTIONS, OUR FIVE AGENT ANIMATORS INKED 1,384 KEYFRAMES AND 2,422 MULTIPLANE GLASS LAYERS!
office_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 1,384 HAND-DRAWN 4:3 KEYFRAMES INKED ACROSS OUR BULLPEN DESKS!
office_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): 2,422 GOUACHE DEPTH PLANES COMPOSITED UNDER THE OVERHEAD CAMERA!
office_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): THE ENTIRE AGENT CREW CELEBRATES AS SHOT #285 STAR LIGHTS THE SCREEN!
office_films.blurb: All 5 Agent Animators—Nib, Blue-Line, Cel-Inker, Sprocket, and Chime—gather across the 4 studio rooms to celebrate completing all 346 multiplane cartoons.

skill_films.category: Establishing Wide -> Action Medium -> Hero Close-Up
skill_films.title: How Nib Directs Camera Pacing Across the Four Rooms
skill_films.speech_p1: A GREAT ANIMATION STUDIO NEVER RUSHES THE VIEWER! WATCH HOW WE PACE SHOT #050 BUTTERFLY FROM SKETCH TO SCREEN!
skill_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 INKER AGENTS DRAW THE WINGBEAT POSES K1..K4 AT UNHURRIED RHYTHM!
skill_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): CEL-INKER COMPOSITES THE GARDEN BLOSSOMS AND FLUTTERING BUTTERFLY!
skill_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): ON OUR 4:3 SCREEN, EVERY WINGBEAT READS WITH CRYSTAL CLARITY!
skill_films.blurb: Nib demonstrates how deliberate studio pacing across the Storyboard Room, 4-Desk Bullpen, Multiplane Tower, and Screening Theatre lets the viewer savor every wingbeat.

skill_films.title: Operating the Multiplane Camera Dolly on Shot #042 Campfire
skill_films.speech_p1: TO MAKE THE NIGHT WOODS FEEL DEEP AROUND THE CAMPFIRE, CEL-INKER AND I RIG SEVEN SEPARATE GLASS LEVELS!
skill_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 INKER AGENTS PAINT THE FLICKERING FLAME POSES K1..K4 IN WARM GOUACHE!
skill_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): NIB CRANKS THE DOLLY WHEEL AS PINE TREES AND FLAMES SHIFT IN PARALLAX!
skill_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): THE CAMPFIRE GLOWS WARMLY ON OUR 4:3 SCREENING ROOM THEATRE SCREEN!
skill_films.blurb: Watch Cel-Inker and Nib load the night sky, pine woods, riverbank logs, and flickering campfire cels into the Multiplane Tower and crank the camera dolly.

skill_films.title: How Our Agent Crew Blocks Shot #071 Clock Before Rolling
skill_films.speech_p1: BEFORE WE ROLL TAKE ONE ON SHOT #071 CLOCK, EVERY AGENT STATION LOCKS REGISTRATION PEGS AND MARGINS!
skill_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 INKER AGENTS ALIGN THE CLOCK HANDS & PENDULUM ON 4:3 PEGBAR SHEETS!
skill_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): LOCKING THE TABLETOP WALLPAPER, SHADOW, AND CLOCK FACE PLATENS!
skill_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): CHIME TAPS THE TICK-TOCK FOLEY AS THE 4:3 CLOCK REEL PASSES TAKE ONE!
skill_films.blurb: Blue-Line and Sprocket walk through the Take-One pre-roll protocol across all 4 studio rooms, ensuring zero margin clipping and frame-accurate pendulum timing.

skill_films.title: From Raw Archival Video to Hand-Inked Multiplane Cel
skill_films.speech_p1: WE NEVER FILTER PHOTOREAL VIDEO! WATCH HOW OUR AGENT CREW RE-INKS THE ARCHIVAL GIRAFFE FROM SCRATCH!
skill_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): TRACING BLUE ROUGHS -> BLACK INDIA INK -> GOUACHE ACROSS 4 DESKS!
skill_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): COMPOSITING THE SAVANNA SKY, ACACIA TREES, AND RE-INKED GIRAFFE!
skill_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): COMPARE THE 4:3 ARCHIVAL MONITOR BESIDE OUR 4:3 REANIMATED CARTOON!
skill_films.blurb: See the complete Reanimate pipeline in action: tracing the motion spine on the Room 1 Moviola, redrawing 4 keyframes at the Room 2 lightboxes, stacking 7 planes in Room 3, and comparing both 4:3 screens in Room 4.

skill_films.title: How Sprocket Enforces All 16 Quality Gates Across the Studio
skill_films.speech_p1: IF A HOT-AIR BALLOON CLIPS THE FRAME BORDER, I HALT THE LINE! WATCH HOW WE GUARD SHOT #152 AT EVERY STATION!
skill_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 INKER AGENTS KEEP THE RISING BALLOON INSIDE SAFE 4:3 MARGINS!
skill_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): VERIFYING PARALLAX SEPARATION BETWEEN HIGH CLOUDS AND THE BALLOON!
skill_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): SPROCKET AUDITS THE 4:3 PROJECTION AND STAMPS 16/16 GATES PASS!
skill_films.blurb: Follow Auditor Sprocket through all 4 studio rooms to see how margin safety, 4:3 aspect lock, line boil, and parallax separation are verified on Shot #152 Hot-Air Balloon.

skill_films.category: Visual Storytelling by Showing the Studio in Action
skill_films.title: Showing Our Agent Animators at Work Instead of Telemetry
skill_films.speech_p1: THE BEST WAY TO EXPLAIN OUR STUDIO IS TO OPEN THE DOORS AND LET YOU WATCH OUR AGENT ANIMATORS MAKE A FILM!
skill_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): WATCH THE 4 LIGHTHOUSE KEYFRAMES GROW FROM PENCIL ROUGH TO PAINTED CEL!
skill_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): WATCH THE 3 GLASS LEVELS COMBINE INTO THE FULL VIEWFINDER SCENE!
skill_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): WATCH THE FINISHED 4:3 FILM ROLL IN OUR STUDIO SCREENING ROOM!
skill_films.blurb: Nib opens the doors to all 4 rooms of Secondhand Studios so you can watch the agent animators trace, ink, paint, stack, crank, and project a cartoon from start to finish.

skill_films.title: Mixing the Same Five Gouache Colors Across Every Room
skill_films.speech_p1: WHY DO ALL 346 FILMS FEEL LIKE ONE UNIFIED WORLD? BECAUSE EVERY ROOM IN OUR STUDIO USES THE SAME INK & GOUACHE!
skill_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): ALL 4 INKER DESKS SHARE OUR WARM ARCHIVAL PAPER & SPEEDBALL INDIA INK!
skill_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): CEL-INKER GLAZES EVERY GLASS PLANE IN OUR 5 SIGNATURE GOUACHE WASHES!
skill_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): THE FINISHED 4:3 GUITAR REEL MATCHES ALL 346 FILMS IN THE ARCHIVE!
skill_films.blurb: Sprocket and Nib show how standardizing warm bond paper, Speedball India ink, and 5 gouache washes across all 4 studio rooms unifies the entire 346-shot catalog.

skill_films.title: How Chime Strikes Foley Sound Effects on Motion Peaks
skill_films.speech_p1: HOW DOES SILENT INK GET ITS VOICE? WE TRACK ACCELERATION PEAKS FROM THE MOVIOLA ALL THE WAY TO MY FOLEY STAGE!
skill_films.caption_p2: ROOM 2 (WORKTREE BULLPEN): 4 INKER AGENTS MARK RED FOLEY CUE DOTS ON KEYFRAMES K1, K2, K3 & K4!
skill_films.caption_p3: ROOM 3 (MULTIPLANE TOWER): NIB LOCKS THE CAMERA SHUTTER PULSES TO THE X-SHEET TIMING MARKS!
skill_films.caption_p4: ROOM 4 (SCREENING THEATRE): CHIME STRIKES THE FOLEY PROPS IN SYNC WITH THE 4:3 STEAM TRAIN!
skill_films.blurb: Follow Foley Percussionist Chime from the Room 1 Moviola through the bullpen and Multiplane Tower to the Room 4 Foley Stage, striking acoustic cues on the exact frames of peak acceleration.
